# Historical legacy parser fixtures

The `.zr` files in this directory preserve pre-cutover parser and script
examples. They are not current language inputs and are excluded from the
Syntax 06B repository promotion scan as `historicalLegacyParserFixture`.

Current executable project fixtures live under `tests/fixtures/projects`.
Legacy constructs used for migration behavior live under the dedicated
`syntax_migration_*` fixtures. Do not add current syntax coverage here.
